name: Sticky Add-to-Cart Bar
summary: Target-controlled viewport-edge secondary submitter that reuses one canonical Product Form through canonical Button and target-formatted Price composition.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Neutral viewport-edge composition; Web targets exclude the hidden subtree from interaction and the accessibility tree.

anatomy.name: inner
anatomy.description: Private intrinsic wrapper for product identity and purchase action.

anatomy.name: info
anatomy.description: Product identity and target-formatted Price group.

anatomy.name: price
anatomy.description: Optional wrapper containing one canonical target-formatted Price.

anatomy.name: action
anatomy.description: Canonical Button that submits the existing Product Form rather than starting an independent cart path.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic container-responsive profile; geometry remains private.

states.name: hidden
states.description: Target-hidden state while the primary action remains useful or eligibility is unresolved; on Web the subtree is inert, accessibility-hidden, non-interactive, and translated outside the visual surface.

states.name: visible
states.description: Target-visible state after the primary Product Form action is no longer usefully visible and the target has resolved a coherent eligible product state.

states.name: unavailable
states.description: The coordinated selection became unavailable while the surface is present; the target may instead omit K9, and a rendered canonical Button carries disabled without aria-busy=true.

states.name: pending
states.description: Target purchase work is pending; the canonical Button carries aria-busy=true plus disabled, preserves the visible label, and blocks repeat submission.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The target owns observation, thresholds, hysteresis and lifecycle, and exposes K9 only when the primary action is no longer usefully visible and product eligibility is coherent. Hidden Web descendants remain unavailable rather than merely translated below the viewport.

behavior.name: externalFormSubmit
behavior.description: The canonical Button is an explicit external submitter for one existing native Product Form and preserves activated-submitter and successful-entry semantics.

behavior.name: dependencyComposition
behavior.description: K9 contains one canonical Price slot when supplied and one canonical Button; it does not duplicate their markup, formatting, states, focus, or visual ownership.

behavior.name: targetProductCoordination
behavior.description: One target product coordinator synchronizes selected merchandise, quantity, selling plan, Price, media, availability, visibility eligibility, pending/result state, cart updates, deliberate feedback, analytics, focus and the stable Product Form reference.

behavior.name: targetCollisionManagement
behavior.description: Every fixed target mapping accounts for safe-area insets, reserves sufficient block-end content or scroll space and coordinates virtual keyboards, Bottom Nav, Cookie Consent, Cart Drawer, chat and other fixed surfaces so focused and checkout-critical controls are not obscured.

behavior.name: intrinsicLayout
behavior.description: Stable source order responds to the K9 container, wraps localized and unbroken content, and avoids viewport-dependent internal composition or hidden semantic content.

properties.name: visible
properties.description: Projects target-owned semantic visibility after the primary action is no longer useful and product eligibility is coherent; observation mechanics remain outside K9.

properties.name: image
properties.description: Optional target-owned product thumbnail with intrinsic dimensions and loading policy.

properties.name: imageAlt
properties.description: Target-authored alternative text; use empty text only when the adjacent title already communicates the same product identity.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Required non-empty localized product title plaintext.

properties.name: price
properties.description: Optional slot containing one canonical target-formatted Price.

properties.name: actionLabel
properties.description: Required non-empty localized visible label for the canonical purchase Button.

properties.name: productFormId
properties.description: Stable target Product Form reference; on Web it is the native form-owner id for the external submitter.

properties.name: actionDisabled
properties.description: Projects an unavailable resolved selection from the target coordinator to the canonical Button.

properties.name: pending
properties.description: Projects target-owned asynchronous purchase work to canonical Button busy and disabled semantics.

accessibility: Use a real external submit button associated with the one canonical native Product Form; preserve its validation, activated submitter and FormData semantics.
Keep hidden Web content inert, accessibility-hidden and non-interactive rather than relying on visual translation or a single descendant tabIndex.
Keep Price target formatted, product title and action label visible, optional media alternatives correct, and unavailable reasons evident in adjacent product content.
Use canonical Button busy semantics for pending work, preserve the visible action label and prevent repeat submission.
Keep result status, focus, errors and announcements in the one target purchase/cart lifecycle; K9 is not a live region.
Account for safe-area insets and reserve enough block-end content or scroll space that the fixed surface never completely obscures focused or checkout-critical content.
Honor reduced motion, forced colors, safe areas, logical direction and effective 200 percent reflow without horizontal overflow or hidden product context.

web.notes: Canonical composition and intrinsic state CSS need no neutral runtime. Target-controlled eligibility, product coordination, purchase lifecycle and safe fixed-surface mapping remain consumer responsibilities.

shopify.notes: Product-context Liquid may associate the external Button with the main product form, but a real Main Product consumer must still prove live option/quantity coordination, eligibility observation, Ajax/native purchase outcomes, feedback, focus, safe-area/collision handling and editor behavior.

react.notes: Framework product feature controls visibility and projects one coordinator into Price, Button and the existing Product Form without a second cart path.
